## Understanding the Main Techniques

### Use-After-Free (UAF)
This vulnerability occurs when a program:
1. Allocates memory for an object
2. Frees the memory
3. Continues to use the freed memory pointer

### Double-Free
This happens when memory is freed twice, potentially corrupting the heap's metadata and creating overlapping chunks.

   - Overwrite pointers of the freed object with addresses of interest (e.g., GOT entries)

4. Leak addresses to defeat ASLR
